evidence.notes: Single-record mode-only upsert creates a local Account and returns an UpsertResult.
Single-record mode-only upsert accepts AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE and updates an existing Account.
Single-record mode-only upsert accepts allOrNone=false and returns an UpsertResult.
Single-record mode-only upsert accepts allOrNone=false plus AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE and returns an UpsertResult.
List mode-only upsert creates ordered local UpsertResult rows.
List mode-only upsert accepts AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE and returns ordered UpsertResult rows.
List mode-only upsert accepts allOrNone=false and returns ordered UpsertResult rows.
List mode-only upsert accepts allOrNone=false plus AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE and returns ordered UpsertResult rows.

source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeDatabaseUpsertModeEvidenceTest { @isTest static void upsertsByIdAndMode() { Account singleCreate = new Account(Name = 'Mode Single Create'); Object singleCreateObject = singleCreate; Database.UpsertResult created = Database.upsert(singleCreateObject); System.assert(created.isSuccess()); System.assert(created.isCreated()); System.assertNotEquals(null, created.getId()); Database.UpsertResult updatedAccess = Database.upsert((Object) new Account(Id = created.getId(), Name = 'Mode Single Access'), AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(updatedAccess.isSuccess()); System.assert(!updatedAccess.isCreated()); System.assertEquals(created.getId(), updatedAccess.getId()); Database.UpsertResult updatedBool = Database.upsert((Object) new Account(Id = created.getId(), Name = 'Mode Single Bool'), false); System.assert(updatedBool.isSuccess()); System.assert(!updatedBool.isCreated()); Database.UpsertResult updatedBoth = Database.upsert((Object) new Account(Id = created.getId(), Name = 'Mode Single Both'), false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(updatedBoth.isSuccess()); System.assert(!updatedBoth.isCreated()); List<Object> createRows = new List<Object>{new Account(Name = 'Mode List One'), new Account(Name = 'Mode List Two')}; List<Database.UpsertResult> createdRows = Database.upsert(createRows); System.assertEquals(2, createdRows.size()); System.assert(createdRows[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(createdRows[0].isCreated()); System.assert(createdRows[1].isSuccess()); System.assert(createdRows[1].isCreated()); List<Object> accessRows = new List<Object>{new Account(Id = createdRows[0].getId(), Name = 'Mode List One Access'), new Account(Id = createdRows[1].getId(), Name = 'Mode List Two Access')}; List<Database.UpsertResult> accessResults = Database.upsert(accessRows, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, accessResults.size()); System.assert(accessResults[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(!accessResults[0].isCreated()); List<Object> boolRows = new List<Object>{new Account(Id = createdRows[0].getId(), Name = 'Mode List One Bool'), new Account(Name = 'Mode List Three')}; List<Database.UpsertResult> boolResults = Database.upsert(boolRows, false); System.assertEquals(2, boolResults.size()); System.assert(boolResults[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(!boolResults[0].isCreated()); System.assert(boolResults[1].isSuccess()); System.assert(boolResults[1].isCreated()); List<Object> bothRows = new List<Object>{new Account(Id = createdRows[1].getId(), Name = 'Mode List Two Both'), new Account(Name = 'Mode List Four')}; List<Database.UpsertResult> bothResults = Database.upsert(bothRows, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, bothResults.size()); System.assert(bothResults[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(!bothResults[0].isCreated()); System.assert(bothResults[1].isSuccess()); System.assert(bothResults[1].isCreated()); System.assertEquals(5, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE 'Mode %']); } }
